question: — I bought you a new dress, would you be happy?
explanation: এটি একটি Second conditional বাক্য। যেখানে Past Indefinite হলে পরের Clause word + V... হবে। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর হবে If।

question: Had I been solvent, your financial issues...... [BPSC-26]
explanation: এটি একটি 3rd conditional বাক্য। ফলে If clause যদি had + V3 হয়, তাহলে মূল Clause হবে Would have + V3. "financial issues" Passive হওয়ায় পরে অংশটুকু Passive-এ হবে। তাই Would have been solved সঠিক।

question: Select the sentence with correct conditional structure. [LGD-26]
options: If he would have followed the design code, the error would not occur.
If he follows the design code, the error would not have occurred.
If he had followed the design code, the error would not have occurred.
If he followed the design code, the error would not have occurred.
explanation: এখানে অপশন (গ) সঠিক। কারণ এটি একটি 3rd Conditional বাক্য। 3rd Conditional বাক্যে If clause-টি Past Perfect হলে পরের Clause- Would + have + V3 হয়। সুতরাং বাক্যটি হবে– 'If he had followed the design code, the error would not have occurred.'

question: No sooner — the inspection report than corrective measures were initiated. [LGD-26]
explanation: 'No sooner' দ্বারা শুরু হওয়া বাক্যের Structure হলো– No sooner + had + sub + V3 (Past Indefinite) + object + than + others. সুতরাং, সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে 'No sooner had the authority submitted the inspection report than corrective measures were initiated.

question: Choose the correct form of the verb : If I — enough money, I would buy a car. [BWDB-26]
explanation: 2nd Conditional বাক্যে Principal clause 'sub + would + V1' থাকলেই If clause Past Indefinite হয়। সুতরাং, "If I had enough money" হবে সঠিক উত্তর।

question: Identify the right option; 'If he —, she will not go.' [MOR-25]
explanation: 1st conditional-এ 'if clause' present tense হলে, পরের clause future tense এর হয়। তাহলে সঠিক উত্তর হবে 'If he comes' ।

question: Select the sentence having correct sub-verb agreement : [BPSC-25]
options: He talks as if he was a king
They jury was not from the same city
He ran fast lest he should have miss the train
explanation: এখানে সঠিক বাক্য হলো I had my door open. কারণ Sentence-টির structure : "Subject + had + object + complement" grammatically correct । অন্যগুলি সঠিক নয়।

question: If he — more careful, he would not make such mistakes. [BPSC-25]
explanation: 2nd Conditional-এ If clause Past Indefinite হয়। তবে সকল Person-এ be verb 'were' হয়।

question: Fill in the blank with the correct words : If I had known it was your birthday, I — you a gift. [BPSC-25]
explanation: 3rd Conditional-এ If + Past Perfect হলে, পরের Clause-এ Sub + would have + v3 হবে। সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর হবে would have bought.

question: We eat to live. (Complex) [NTRCA-2024]
options: We eat and want to live.
We eat so that we may live.
We eat so that we could live.
explanation: প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির Complex structure হবে Sub + V + So that + Sub + Verb. তাহলে বাক্যটি হবে We eat so that we may live.

question: He behaved as though he — everything. [NTRCA-2024]
explanation: 'as though' conjunction-এর পূর্বের অংশ Past Indefinite হলে পরের অংশ Past Perfect হবে। তাহলে শূন্যস্থানে had known হবে।

question: If I had money, I — it now. [KGCL-2024]
explanation: 'If' clause Past Indefinite (2nd conditional) হলে, পরের Clause-এ Would + V1 হয়। এক্ষেত্রে সঠিক উত্তর হবে would purchase।

question: The teacher would understand it if you — it to him more slowly. [BEZA-2024]
explanation: if clause-এর পূর্বে would + V1 থাকলে if clause Past Indefinite Tense-এ হবে। সুতরাং explained সঠিক

question: He runs fast lest he miss the train. [BEZA-2024]
explanation: ১২৯৯ নং প্রশ্নের ব্যাখ্যা দেখুন।

question: I wish if I were rich man, I (help) the poor. [CPGCBL-24]
explanation: এটি একটি Second conditional বাক্য। এর Structure হলো— If + Past simple + Subject + would + v1 (base form of verb) + others. তাহলে পরের Clause হবে I would help the poor.

question: Which of the following is incorrect? [TGTDCL-2023, MES-2025]
explanation:
Tallest — সবচেয়ে লম্বা
Largest — বৃহত্তম
Biggest — বৃহত্তম
Huggest — অর্থ হয় না (X)
সুতরাং Huggest শব্দটি incorrect.

question: Choose the correct option : "No sooner had he reached the station– the train left. [MOE-2023]
explanation: No sooner had-এর সাথে Conjunction হিসেবে than বসে।

question: Select the correct connector. Scarcely had I thought of having ice cream___my mother bought one for me. [BPSC-2022]
explanation: Option (ঘ) when সঠিক উত্তর। Scarcely when হলো একটি Connector। একটি Sentence clause past perfect tense এবং অপরটি past indefinite tense-এর হলে past perfect অংশের আগে no sooner/scarcely/hardly/ হয় এবং past indefinite অংশের আগে that/when হয়।

question: If — I would not lose temper. [BTCL-2022]
explanation: If দ্বারা শুরু Conditional sentence-এর প্রথম অংশের পূর্বের if-এর পূর্বে I were you বসে। তাই (ক) উত্তরটি সঠিক। অপশনের বাকি উত্তরগুলো প্রশ্নের সাথে related নয়।

question: Had I known in advance, I — enough money. [CAAB-2021]
explanation: Option (গ) সঠিক উত্তর। প্রদত্ত Sentence-টি 3rd conditional sentence-এ রয়েছে। Structure : If + past perfect tense + would/ could/ might + have যুক্ত Clause হয়।

question: If I were you, I — take the money. [DNCC-2021]
explanation: এটি একটি Conditionals sentence. If Clause-এর Subject যদি Past tense-এ থাকে, তাহলে পরবর্তী Clause-এ should / would / could / might + মূল verb হয়। যেমন— If I were you, I would take the money.

question: Which of the following sentence is not correct? [KGDCL-2021]
options: He is one of the tall boy in the class.
He is one of the tallest boys in the class.
explanation: “One of the”-এর পরে Superlative degree হয় এবং Plural noun/pronoun হয়। কিন্তু Option (ক)-তে “One of the”-এর পরে positive degree ব্যবহৃত হওয়ায় Sentence-টি সঠিক নয়।

question: Which is the lowest unit in English grammatical hierarchy? [PPA-2020]
explanation: একটি শব্দকে যতভাগে ভাগ করা যায় তার ক্ষুদ্রতম অংশ (Smallest unit of meaning) হলো Morphemes.

question: No sooner had Kashem left Karim came. [BBA-2020]
explanation: ৩৭নং প্রশ্ন দেখুন।

question: Complete the sentence : Rahim has been working—. [WASA-2019]
explanation: ৮২৮নং প্রশ্ন দেখুন।

question: I have no pen to write—. [MOCA-2019]
explanation: কোনো কিছু দিয়ে লেখা অর্থে write with বসে।

question: Scarcely had the game started — the bell rang. [MOCA-2019]
explanation: কোনো Sentence-এ Scarcely had থাকলে অপর Clause-এর সাথে when বসে। অর্থাৎ Scarcely had .......... when ইত্যাদি বসে।

question: Had I known her, I — her. [MOCA-2019]
explanation: If + had + verb এর pp থাকলে পরের clause sub + would have + verb এর + pp হয়। এটি 3rd conditional এর structure। Had + subject pp-ও third conditional সুতরাং উপরের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী হবে।

question: They arrived — we were watching TV. [MOLE-2019]
explanation: While এর পরে subject থাকলে clause-টি Past Continuous form-এ হয়।

question: He talks as if he — everything. [PWD-18]
explanation: As if (যেন) যুক্ত প্রথম Clause-টি Present indefinite, পরেরটা Past indefinite। সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর হবে knew (যা অপশনে নেই)।

question: Choose the right sentence– [PTD-2018]
options: If you run in the rain, you may be catch cold.
If you run in the rain you may have caught cold.
If you run in the rain, you will catch cold.
If you run in the rain you will be catching cold.
explanation: 1st Condition-এ If Clause-টি present Indefinite result clause-টি Future indefinite.

question: If she had enough money, she — him. [RAJUK-2017]
explanation: 2nd Conditional বাক্যে If + had হলে পরের অংশে Sub + would + Verb এর base form হয়।

question: If I had another pen, I — you. [DPHE-2016]
explanation: 2nd conditional-এ If + sub + Past Indefinite + Sub + would / could + verb এর base form + object.
